categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Rehearsal Hall
categories.info: Rehearsal Halls are large-scale challenges that focus on a specific Bananza form. They can only be accessed after finishing the story.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Transition
categories.info: Transitions are Blast Barrel passageways between Sublayers

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Extra-Rare Fossil
categories.info: Extra-Rare Fossils are used for the final upgrade of the showpiece Style Shop items.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

categories.title: Rare Fossil
categories.info: Rare Fossils are used to buy and upgrade showpiece Style Shop items, as well as buy the final upgrade of more common items.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

locations.title: 11 - A Real Mouthful
locations.description: **Location:** Inside a tiny cave on a ledge facing the waterfall.

locations.title: 09 - Smash through the Floor
locations.description:
**Location:** In the 'eyes' of the large stone monkey; grab the ceiling, then hit the Boom Bomb bug when it's above the concrete to gain access.

_Tip: Don't worry if your positioning is off - the bug will respawn after a few seconds._

locations.title: 12 - Rest Stop on Roof Road
locations.description: **Location:** [Hangin' on Roof Road](#loc=466161) - Beyond the first mesh obstacle of the course.

locations.title: 14 - At the End of Roof Road
locations.description: **Location:** [Hangin' on Roof Road](#loc=466161) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 13 - Hidden on Roof Road
locations.description: **Location:** [Hangin' on Roof Road](#loc=466161) - After [Rest Stop on Roof Road](#loc=466162), grab the mesh ceiling and turn left, in the direction of the incoming walls. Punch your way to the end; you'll find a narrow section at the far end, leading to a platform where this banana awaits.

locations.title: 08 - Battle: Both Sides of the Bridge
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for beating [Lagoon Layer Battle Challenge 2](#loc=466172)

locations.title: 26 - Landed in Salvager's Landing
locations.description: **Location:** Near the spot you'll land in when first reaching the sublayer.

locations.title: 27 - Shifty Smash: A Wall Hanging in Air
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=466558)

locations.title: 24 - Blasting for the Banana
locations.description: **Location:** In a hidden cave; Dive Bomb on the nearby panel to blow the wall apart and reveal the cave.

locations.title: 05 - Shifty Smash: Beyond the Wall
locations.description:
**Location:** Reward for destroying the cube of Shifty Stone that appears when you attack the prism here.

_Tip: Use the nearby Boom Bomb to destroy the stone in your way._

locations.title: 07 - A Nook behind Concrete
locations.description:
**Location:** Behind a concrete panel in the ceiling of the cave.

_Tip: You can smash around the concrete to reach it._

locations.title: 29 - Over the Thorny Path
locations.description: **Location:** [Thorn-Choked Conveyor](#loc=466194) - After the first few conveyors.

locations.title: 30 - Into the Thorny Nook
locations.description: **Location:** [Thorn-Choked Conveyor](#loc=466194) - When the path splits, take the left branch. Use the Boom Bombs to destroy the thorns in your way to find this banana behind them.

locations.title: 31 - Through the Thorny Walls
locations.description: **Location:** [Thorn-Choked Conveyor](#loc=466194) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 51 - Dipped into Chimpy Channel!
locations.description: In front of you when you land in Sublayer 102.

locations.title: 39 - Crossed to the Kong Elder's Court!
locations.description: **Location:** Found after raising the water level and crossing the bridge.

locations.title: 04 - Bathing Banana
locations.description: **Location:** Break the dark stone wall right of the Bomb Rock to fall down in a hidden cavern pond with the banana at the bottom.

locations.title: 03 - Lagoon Smashin' Stats
locations.description:
**POST-GAME ONLY**

**Location:** Given by Smashintone after smashing through 5000 cubic metres of water in the Lagoon Layer.

locations.title: 10 - Cranky's Lagoon Rant
locations.description: **Location:** Given by talking to Cranky Kong, standing on the platform. Approach from the giant stone monkey face, and throw rocks at the Shifty Platforms to solidify them and reach the floating island

locations.title: 15 - Lakeside Low Road
locations.description: **Location:** In a small enclosed cave. Break the wall beyond the two green barrels to reveal it.

locations.title: 16 - Battle: Swarms among the Pillars
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Lagoon Layer Battle Challenge 3](#loc=466543)

locations.title: 17 - Follow the Voided Terrain
locations.description: **Location:** At the bottom of a cavern down the water stream. Follow the void track leading away from the banana, smashing obstacles when needed, and break the void seal to unlock the banana.

locations.title: 18 - Fishin' for Bananas
locations.description: **Location:** In a watery cavern beneath the terrain, in the middle of the water. Look over the edge of the map to see a stone ledge leading to the cave.

locations.title: 19 - Rise and Rinse
locations.description: **Location:** Submerged at the bottom of the pool. Punch the blue ballon on a nearby platform repeatedly to raise the banana out of the water.

locations.title: 20 - Placed in a Pipe
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the pipe. To access, climb the pipe from the outside (where it enters the ground) and enter it from the open section that is spilling water.

locations.title: 21 - Shifty Smash: Atop the Pipes
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=466550)

locations.title: 22 - Battle: Wings and the Wobbly Disc
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Lagoon Layer Battle Challenge 4](#loc=466552)

locations.title: 23 - Beyond the Cloudy Platforms
locations.description: **Location:** On the isolated platform; to access, throw stone at the shifty blocks to transform them into walkable platforms.

locations.title: 25 - Lagoon Chip Exchange
locations.description: **Location:** Purchased from the [Chip Exchange](#loc=466556) (which only appears in the post-game) for 10 Banandium Chips.

locations.title: 28 - On the Ceiling of the Floor
locations.description: **Location:** Just underneath Salvager's Landing. Access by progressing the main story until the water level is completely restored so you're close enough to punch up and grab the banana.

locations.title: 32 - The Salvager's Stash
locations.description: **Location:** In an underground room, accessed through a narrow crawlspace just right of the [Style Shop](#loc=466187)

locations.title: 33 - Battle: Concrete-Wall Clash
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Lagoon Layer Battle Challenge 5](#loc=466562)

locations.title: 34 - Up, Over and Across
locations.description: **Location:** In plain sight, in the middle of the island. To reach it, start from the island left of the bridge to the Elder's Court and follow the mesh to the banana.

locations.title: 35 - Within the Fast-Growing Grass
locations.description: **Location:** Underneath the island, accessible from a mesh. Drop down from the island on the small yellow grassy patch to access the mesh.

locations.title: 36 - Hanging on the Orangu-Hang Highway
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the island, after dropping in from [Water Tank Hill](#loc=466569)

locations.title: 37 - Concrete Wall on the Moving Floor
locations.description: **Location:** On Orangu-Tang Highway; past the first mesh, turn around and use a Boom Bomb to destroy the concrete wall above the mesh. Climb in the alcove using the bomb pillar, then destroy the second concrete wall to reveal the banana.

locations.title: 38 - Outskirts of the Fishing Village
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the elevated island. Reach via [Reservoir Outskirts](#loc=466186) and using the moving mesh platforms.

locations.title: 40 - The Ship Stern's Snack
locations.description: **Location:** At the back of the containers; climb along the edges to reach.

locations.title: 55 - Shipwrecked Treasure
locations.description: Through a solid stone wall opposite the [Kong Bananza: Pop Party](#loc=467473) challenge course entrance.

locations.title: 54 - Hung from the Ceiling
locations.description: **Location:** Hanging from a mesh ceiling in [Kong Bananza: Pop Party](#loc=467473).

locations.title: 52 - Pop and Destroy
locations.description: **Location:** Appears after popping five balloons in [Kong Bananza: Pop Party](#loc=467473).

locations.title: 53 - Atop the Concrete Roof
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the maze in [Kong Bananza: Pop Party](#loc=467473).

locations.title: 41 - Past the First Scrappin' Ground
locations.description: **Location:** [Kong Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=494577) - Found after smashing through a group of Crockoids in a room with concrete pillars.

locations.title: 42 - Lure and Destroy!
locations.description: **Location:** [Kong Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=494577) - Reward for destroying three enemies on moving platforms in the First-Scrap Detour.

locations.title: 43 - Past the Second Scrappin' Ground!

locations.title: 44 - Lift and Destroy!
locations.description: **Location:** [Kong Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=494577) - Reward for defeating two Munchoid enemies in the Second-Scrap Detour.

locations.title: 45 - Past the Third Scrappin' Ground
locations.description: **Location:** [Kong Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=494577) - Reward for reaching the end of the third scrappin' ground.

locations.title: 46 - Wallop and Destroy!
locations.description: **Location:** [Kong Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=494577) - Reward for crushing two Crockoids with the help of two Wallopoids in the Third-Scrap Detour.

locations.title: 47 - Past the Fourth Scrappin' Ground
locations.description: **Location:** [Kong Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=494577) - Reward for getting past the fourth scrappin' ground.

locations.title: 48 - Launch and Destroy!
locations.description: **Location:** [Kong Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=494577) - Reward for knocking Squeeloids into the dangling enemies in the Fourth-Scrappin' Detour.

locations.title: 49 - Bounce and Destroy!
locations.description: **Location:** [Kong Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=494577) - Reward for knocking balls into enemies standing on floating thorns in the Fifth-Scrappin' Detour.

locations.title: 50 - Past the Fifth Scrappin' Ground!
locations.description: **Location:** [Kong Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=494577) - Reward for getting past the final scrappin' ground.

locations.title: 56 - Lagoon Hide-and-Seek
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for finding [Hiddentone 1](#loc=494591), [Hiddentone 2](#loc=494592), [Hiddentone 3](#loc=494590) and [Hiddentone 4](#loc=494589).

locations.title: Red Britches
locations.description:
**Effect:** Increases your swimming speed by 10 percent.

**Cost:** 1 Ammonite

locations.title: Swimmin' Britches
locations.description:
**Effect:** Increases your swimming speed by 15 percent.

**Cost:** 5 Ammonites

**Upgrades:**
- Increase to 20 percent: 10x Ammonites
- Increase to 25 percent: 3x Anomalocaris

locations.title: Treasure Tie
locations.description:
**Effect:** Increases the chance a treasure chest will appear as you destroy terrain by 10 percent

**Cost:** 1 Anomalocaris

**Upgrades:**
- Increase to 20 percent: 3x Anomalocaris
- Increase to 30 percent: 1x Whale
